title: Elevate UI Readability: Master CSS 'hyphens' for Flawless Text Flow
tweet: Improve UI readability and text flow with CSS 'hyphens'. Say goodbye to awkward gaps and hello to elegant text blocks, especially in narrow columns. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UX
tip: Employ CSS 'hyphens: auto' on your paragraph elements to allow browsers to automatically hyphenate words, significantly improving text justification and reducing large, unsightly gaps in your UI. Pair with 'text-align: justify' for newspaper-like elegance, ensuring a smoother reading experience in compact layouts.
